_comment: Complete mlai-trade config template. Copy to ~/mlai-trade/config/mlai-trade.json and replace placeholders. Never commit the real mlai-trade.json file.

providers._comment: Enable at least one provider. Alpaca is implemented today. Use providers.other as the generic enablement map for future provider modules.

alpaca._comment: Alpaca provider settings. accounts[] supports multiple paper and/or individual brokerage accounts. account_mode: paper or individual. data_feed: auto, sip, or iex.

accounts._comment: A paper account. Paper accounts obey IRS rule simulation in a separate paper compliance universe.
accounts.name: paper-main

accounts._comment: Example real-money account. Real accounts share IRS/tax compliance blockers across all real provider accounts.
accounts.name: individual-main

fred._comment: FRED API key for S&P 500/VIX/macro features.

tax._comment: Federal tax estimate inputs. filing_status: single, married_filing_jointly, married_filing_separately, or head_of_household. estimated_annual_income is treated as estimated annual taxable ordinary income before trading gains. Paper accounts are excluded from tax estimates by default. brackets_file contains all IRS bracket/rate data and should be updated by JSON diff when IRS publishes a new year.

daemon._comment: Daemon mode runs the automatic auto-trade cycle and tax estimate refresh. start refuses to run unless enabled=true. auto_trade_interval_seconds is clamped to 10-300 seconds. Default pid_file=~/mlai-trade/tmp/mlai-trade.pid and log_file=~/mlai-trade/logs/mlai-trade-daemon.log. Logs rotate daily to YYYYMMDD-<log-file>.gz.

api._comment: Unix-socket API service. start refuses to run unless enabled=true. The API exposes only the allowlisted actions documented by `mlai-trade api status`; runtime is intentionally not exposed. Defaults: socket_file=~/mlai-trade/api/mlai-trade-api.sock, pid_file=~/mlai-trade/tmp/mlai-trade-api.pid, log_file=~/mlai-trade/logs/mlai-trade-api.log. The socket file is chmod 0600. request_timeout_seconds is for normal calls; long_request_timeout_seconds is used for ML refresh and feed sync. Logs rotate daily to YYYYMMDD-<log-file>.gz.

logging._comment: Component JSONL logs. Empty paths use logs/mlai-trade-data.log, logs/mlai-trade-ml.log, logs/mlai-trade-training.log, and logs/mlai-trade-feeds.log. All application logs are JSON lines and rotate daily to YYYYMMDD-<log-file>.gz.

feeds._comment: Feed collection and ML feature integration. Before ML training, mlai-trade builds a managed feed universe from current S&P 500 symbols, open positions, recent provider buys, latest Q1 ML candidates, and extra_symbols. Current S&P 500 membership is only a feed collection universe, not a historical membership feature. Managed subscriptions are reconciled each run so stale symbols are removed; manual `feeds add` subscriptions are kept.

scan._comment: Market-data downloader controls. max_concurrent=1 is conservative for rate limits; increase only if the provider plan supports it.

backend._comment: ML backend selection. LSTM supports auto/cpu/mlx/tch. XGBoost supports auto/cpu/cuda when compiled with XGBoost support. LightGBM and Ridge are CPU-only in this Rust code today, so keep them as cpu.

auto._comment: Auto-trade strategy defaults. DB auto config can override these at runtime through mlai-trade auto config, but every supported key is listed here. Default log_file=~/mlai-trade/logs/mlai-trade-auto.log. Auto log entries are JSON lines and include source=daemon or source=cli. Logs rotate daily to YYYYMMDD-<log-file>.gz.

market._comment: Market clock guardrails. mode=auto uses Alpaca v3 calendar + v3 clock plus local exchange clock. mode=provider uses provider only. mode=local uses local configured schedule only. Alpaca v3 calendar is queried in UTC; timezone controls local exchange-hour guardrails and is stored with DB trade records.

compliance._comment: Hard legal/regulatory floors are compiled into the code, not configured here. blocked_symbols is user/company policy and supports multiple symbols. Input is normalized to uppercase, so meta/Meta/META all match market symbol META. IRS wash-sale days are fixed at 30. This buffer defaults to 1 and cannot be lowered below 1, so replacement buys are blocked for 31 days by default.
